描述_EN: the value and sophistication of the container were proportionate to the importance of the recipient and had special social significance. the inside is plain so that it could accommodate different types of food. the recipient of the box would have returned it with another gift enclosed as a sign of gratitude. the surface design of this box is known as jian huan, literally 'sword pommel rings', and was obtained by carving the alternating layers of red and black lacquer applied to the wooden base. this fine lacquer box was used in the 16th century to present edible gifts.
描述_ZN: 该容器的价值和精致程度与接受者的重要性成正比，具有特殊的社会意义。 里面是素色的，这样就可以容纳不同类型的食物。 收礼者会将盒内的另一份礼物归还，以示感谢。 这个盒子的表面设计被称为 "剑环"，字面意思是 "剑柄环"，是通过雕刻涂在木质底座上的红色和黑色的漆层而得到的。 这个精美的漆盒在16世纪被用来赠送可食用的礼物。
